variants.title: Losing Count
variants.premise: Tallying spice sacks, losing count; reviewer.json scene, drink beat from writer-a.json.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can you get me on a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nilsal. You've made me lose count.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He starts again at the first sack.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Crews won't take a stranger. Ask them yourself.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Why wouldn't they?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nobody's vouched for you. That's the whole of it.

options.label: Who'd have to vouch for me?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Someone with a ledger and a worse temper.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not me. I lift things.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Those two? They're for looking at.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: They're armed.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So's the blacksmith.

options.label: Where can I get a drink?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Flaming Arrow. Ask for the sunbeam ale.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is it any good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You'll thank me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Sixty-one, sixty-two...

variants.title: Puts It Down
variants.premise: He puts the rope down at the quiver; reviewer.json beats, directions from writer-a.json.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a ship out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He puts the rope down and looks at the quiver.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. You don't see those on the wharf.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: It's from the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know what it is. Go and see the registrar.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Dock building, desk at the back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: She's the one with the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It's more than anyone here has. Try it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Me? I dropped a crate last week.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Go on. She doesn't wait about.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Mind the ropes.
